label: Functional-organ example and the limited common-sense case
paraphrase: Schaffer uses the organism and its functionally integrated organs as a tentative common-sense example of whole-first priority, citing Aristotle; at the end of this common-sense argument he gives such intuitive support little weight and at most a default status. This is a reading of his argument, not an established actual material-dependence edge or a new direct attribution to Aristotle.
